text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Storming through the final 1200 meters and 
conquering all three races, Sakura 
Bakushin O trembles with pure joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, the Trainer suggested 
entering the Sprinters Stakes—where 
Nishino Flower was also running—to test 
her newly grown strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O, who longed for a 
rematch with Nishino Flower... Believing 
that this truly, truly was the very last 
one—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She decided to run in the Sprinters Stakes 
for the second time.
